rationale: No established normal-load overcurrent duration justifies added blanking. Retain fastest supported response as the prototype candidate; nuisance-trip and fault-energy qualification remain open.

published_open_response.condition: IOUT > ILIM + 30 percent to VOUT falling

capacitor_relation: t = C * deltaV / Idischarge; does not include guaranteed propagation delay
prohibited_inferences: Peak current below a simulation threshold proves no hardware trips
Fastest response proves MOSFET, wiring or load fault-energy compliance
revisit_condition: Add blanking only if bounded normal current excursions require it and worst-case passed energy is compatible with selected parts
